candidate_title: Assisted Declarative Process Creation from Natural Language Descriptions

review_output.decision_rationale: The title and abstract indicate that natural-language descriptions are used to create declarative process models, and that NLP techniques are included to identify roles/activities/constraints from text and support mapping text elements to process-model elements—an observable signal for NLP-driven process extraction/construction from natural language.
